verdict.rationale: Instinct documents proactive follow-ups and texting or calling the user. Hands-on reviewers describe delegated tasks it ran on its own and reported back on in the same chat, including ongoing podcast-booking follow-ups where it pinged the user only when needed. However, nothing shows explicit time-based scheduling: neither a recurring schedule nor a one-off task set to run at a future time. Missing for 10: documented recurring/cron-style scheduling, explicit deferred one-off scheduling at a set time, first-party docs describing task scheduling and result delivery.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results
